ASH - Archaic Sealed Heat.name: ASH: Archaic Sealed Heat
ASH - Archaic Sealed Heat.summary: Newly crowned Queen Aisya has to find the bracelet of her kingdom of Millinear in order to restore it after the fiend named Salamander put it to ruin. ASH: Archaic Sealed Heat is a game of mixed RPG genres with movement being done as a turn based tactical RPG and the combat itself being carried out in a traditional turn based RPG style. Players can only control up to three characters when in turn based battle. The game also features permadeath so taking care of characters is of utmost importance.

Astro Boy - The Video Game.name: Astro Boy: The Video Game
Astro Boy - The Video Game.summary:
Astro Boy centers around a boy-robot named Astro that tries to bridge the relationship between humans and robots. This game is based on the computer-animated superhero film named "Astro Boy".
This Nintendo DS version offers a different artstyle and more classic 2D platforming experience compared to the PSP, PS2 and Wii versions that utilize more 3D-looking graphics while keeping the platforming to a more 2,5D experience
